content_text: That’s the effect of a mistimed shutter in a movie camera, though they might have used VFX to simulate it. You can see it in parts of the D-Day battle in “Saving Private Ryan”. When the shutter is mistimed, the film starts to get pulled-down to the next frame before the shutter is closed or while it is opening so a percentage of the exposure is streaked (the highlights, since they register first on film). I’m sure there are some post plug-ins for “shutter timing error VFX” or something.
